halo.$description: Primary signature halo. Discreet, top-right. Reserved for large surfaces (hero, section backgrounds).

halo-soft.$description: Secondary, lower-opacity halo layered under `halo` on hero-scale surfaces.

halo-strong.$description: Higher-opacity halo variant (0.16), used on the hero section.

shadow-drop.$description: Default drop shadow for elevated dark-surface cards.

glow-signal.$description: Signal-colored glow, e.g. behind the live dot / signal CTA.
